LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.title: 對話一 · Dialogue 1
LESSON_TWO_DIALOGUE_ONE.setting: 在中明家 · At Zhongming’s place

text.traditional: 今天是星期一，你不去學校嗎？
text.simplified: 今天是星期一，你不去学校吗？
text.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqí yī, nǐ bú qù xuéxiào ma?
text.english: It is Monday today; aren’t you going to school?

text.traditional: 我早上沒有課，九點去圖書館。
text.simplified: 我早上没有课，九点去图书馆。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang méi yǒu kè, jiǔ diǎn qù túshūguǎn.
text.english: I don’t have class in the morning. I am going to the library at 9:00.

text.traditional: 中午呢？你中午回家嗎？
text.simplified: 中午呢？你中午回家吗？
text.pinyin: Zhōngwǔ ne? Nǐ zhōngwǔ huí jiā ma?
text.english: How about noon? Are you coming back home at noon?

text.traditional: 我下午有課，中午不回家。
text.simplified: 我下午有课，中午不回家。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ yǒu kè, zhōngwǔ bù huí jiā.
text.english: I have class in the afternoon; I am not coming home at noon.

text.traditional: 你幾點下課？
text.simplified: 你几点下课？
text.pinyin: Nǐ jǐ diǎn xiàkè?
text.english: What time do you get out of class?

text.traditional: 我四點四十分下課。
text.simplified: 我四点四十分下课。
text.pinyin: Wǒ sì diǎn sìshí fēn xiàkè.
text.english: I get out of class at 4:40.

LESSON_TWO_GRAMMAR_ONE.lessonTitleEnglish: What Time Do You Go to School?
LESSON_TWO_GRAMMAR_ONE.learnerPromise: Ask and answer when something happens using a date, weekday, or clock time.
LESSON_TWO_GRAMMAR_ONE.explanation: Dates and clock times put the number before the unit: 五月十六號, 九點二十分. Weekdays go the opposite way: say 星期 first, then the number: 星期四.

teachingGlossary.meaning: is; optional in these time expressions
how many; asks for a number
day number in a date (spoken form)
day number in a date (written form)

LESSON_TWO_GRAMMAR_ONE.pattern: Number + time word + number + measure word

discoveryLab.title: Build time from big pieces to small pieces
discoveryLab.description: Choose what you want to say. The markers tell the listener whether your numbers mean a date, weekday, or clock time.
discoveryLab.prompt: Which kind of time do you need?

choices.label: Date
choices.note: Month comes first: 五月. The spoken date ends with 號.

choices.label: Weekday
choices.note: 星期 comes before the number: 星期四. Numbers one to six give Monday to Saturday; Sunday uses 星期天 or 星期日.

choices.label: Clock time
choices.note: Say the hour with 點, then the minute number with 分.

choices.label: Ask with 幾
choices.note: Replace the unknown number with 幾. Keep its time marker after it.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Large unit first, small unit second: month then date, hour then minute. 星期 is different: it comes before its number.

subsections.title: Date · 月 / 號
subsections.explanation: The month comes before the day: 五月十六號. A spoken date ends with 號, or 日 in writing.

columns.meaning: day number in a date (spoken form)
day number in a date (written form)

subsections.title: Weekday · 星期
subsections.explanation: 星期 comes first, then the number: 星期四.

subsections.title: Clock time · 點 / 分
subsections.explanation: Say the hour with 點, then the minute number with 分: 九點二十分.

items.question: Where does the weekday number go?
items.answer: Put the number after 星期: 星期一.

words.meaning: is; optional in these time expressions

items.question: What is the difference between 幾點 and 星期幾?
items.answer: 幾點 asks the clock time. 星期幾 asks the weekday, and your answer must match.

words.meaning: is; optional in these time expressions

items.question: Which comes first, the month or the date?
items.answer: The month. Big units come first, and a spoken date ends with 號: 十二月七號.

right.pinyin: Jīntiān shì shí'èr yuè qī hào.

words.meaning: is; optional in these time expressions
day number in a date (spoken form)

examples.teachingNote: Use 幾 in each unknown number slot.

text.english: A: What time is it now? B: It is 10:15 now.

LESSON_TWO_GRAMMAR_THREE.lessonTitleEnglish: What Time Do You Go to School?
LESSON_TWO_GRAMMAR_THREE.titleEnglish: Say What Someone Has with 有 or 沒有
LESSON_TWO_GRAMMAR_THREE.learnerPromise: Say whether someone has a friend, class, phone, child, or other thing.
LESSON_TWO_GRAMMAR_THREE.explanation: 有 says what someone has. To say “do not have,” replace 有 with 沒有. Never negate 有 with 不.

teachingGlossary.meaning: ending word for a yes/no question

discoveryLab.title: 有 has its own negative partner
discoveryLab.description: Switch between having and not having by changing only the middle block.
discoveryLab.prompt: Does she have a Taiwanese friend?

choices.label: Has · 有
choices.note: 有 sits between the person and the thing they have.

choices.label: New classmate
choices.note: Same shape: person, then 有, then the thing.

choices.label: Does not have · 沒有
choices.english: Mr. Wang does not have children.
choices.note: Negate 有 with 沒有, never with 不.

discoveryLab.takeaway: 有 becomes 沒有 in a negative sentence.

items.question: Why can’t I say 不有?
items.answer: 有 takes its own negative partner, 沒有. Never put 不 in front of 有.

right.english: Mr. Wang does not have children.

items.question: Can 是 and 有 both connect these words?
items.answer: Use 有 alone to say what she has: 她有台灣朋友.

text.traditional: 我們有新同學。
text.simplified: 我们有新同学。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu xīn tóngxué.
text.english: We have a new classmate.

examples.teachingNote: The question uses 有; the negative answer uses 沒有.

text.traditional: A：王先生有孩子嗎？ B：王先生沒有孩子。
text.simplified: A：王先生有孩子吗？ B：王先生没有孩子。
text.pinyin: A: Wáng xiānshēng yǒu háizi ma? B: Wáng xiānshēng méi yǒu háizi.
text.english: A: Does Mr. Wang have children? B: Mr. Wang does not have children.

words.meaning: ending word for a yes/no question

text.traditional: A：你今天有課嗎？ B：我今天下午有課。
text.simplified: A：你今天有课吗？ B：我今天下午有课。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ jīntiān yǒu kè ma? B: Wǒ jīntiān xiàwǔ yǒu kè.
text.english: A: Do you have class today? B: I have class this afternoon.

words.meaning: ending word for a yes/no question

LESSON_TWO_GRAMMAR_TWO.lessonTitleEnglish: What Time Do You Go to School?
LESSON_TWO_GRAMMAR_TWO.titleTraditional: 主語 + 時間 + 動作
LESSON_TWO_GRAMMAR_TWO.learnerPromise: Say when you go, return, study, or do another action.
LESSON_TWO_GRAMMAR_TWO.explanation: Put the time before the verb, as in 他八點回家。

discoveryLab.title: Give the listener the time before the event
discoveryLab.description: The book’s table: the time word sits between the subject and the action.
discoveryLab.prompt: Where does the time block belong?

choices.label: Time before the action
choices.pinyin: Wǒ jiǔ diǎn sānshí fēn shàngkè.
choices.note: The time 九點三十分 sits right before the action 上課.

choices.label: Time with 沒有
choices.english: He does not have class today.
choices.note: After 他 comes the time 今天, then 沒有課.

choices.label: Ask when
choices.english: What time do you go to the library?
choices.note: 幾點 fills the same time position as a clock answer.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Say who, then when, then the action.

items.question: Why can’t the time go at the end, like in English?
items.answer: The time word always comes before the verb: 他八點回家, never 他回家八點.

items.question: Where does 今天 go when the verb is negated?
items.answer: Put 今天 before 沒有課: 他今天沒有課.

right.english: He does not have class today.

text.traditional: 我九點三十分上課。
text.simplified: 我九点三十分上课。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiǔ diǎn sānshí fēn shàngkè.
text.english: I start class at 9:30.

text.traditional: 他今天沒有課。
text.simplified: 他今天没有课。
text.pinyin: Tā jīntiān méi yǒu kè.
text.english: He does not have class today.

text.traditional: 你幾點去圖書館？
text.simplified: 你几点去图书馆？
text.pinyin: Nǐ jǐ diǎn qù túshūguǎn?
text.english: What time do you go to the library?

LESSON_TWO_GRAMMAR_TWO.exerciseInstruction: These questions are about you. Put the time before the action in your answer.

questions.repairFeedback: Choose the hour before 點; the model keeps 十五分.

segments.hint: Say 我, then the weekday, then 不去學校.

dialogue.title: 對話一 · Dialogue 1
dialogue.setting: 在中明家 · At Zhongming’s place

text.traditional: 今天是星期一，你不去學校嗎？
text.simplified: 今天是星期一，你不去学校吗？
text.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqí yī, nǐ bú qù xuéxiào ma?
text.english: It is Monday today; aren’t you going to school?

text.traditional: 我早上沒有課，九點去圖書館。
text.simplified: 我早上没有课，九点去图书馆。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang méi yǒu kè, jiǔ diǎn qù túshūguǎn.
text.english: I don’t have class in the morning. I am going to the library at 9:00.

text.traditional: 中午呢？你中午回家嗎？
text.simplified: 中午呢？你中午回家吗？
text.pinyin: Zhōngwǔ ne? Nǐ zhōngwǔ huí jiā ma?
text.english: How about noon? Are you coming back home at noon?

text.traditional: 我下午有課，中午不回家。
text.simplified: 我下午有课，中午不回家。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ yǒu kè, zhōngwǔ bù huí jiā.
text.english: I have class in the afternoon; I am not coming home at noon.

text.traditional: 你幾點下課？
text.simplified: 你几点下课？
text.pinyin: Nǐ jǐ diǎn xiàkè?
text.english: What time do you get out of class?

text.traditional: 我四點四十分下課。
text.simplified: 我四点四十分下课。
text.pinyin: Wǒ sì diǎn sìshí fēn xiàkè.
text.english: I get out of class at 4:40.
